Kinachohamishwa: “Tumia iliyopo” (kubadilisha)

Kubadilisha saleMode kwenye bidhaa ile ile — hakuna nakala.

Kwa nini saleCopyTemplate() na sio duplicateTemplate()

Uchunguzi: duplicateTemplate kwa makusudi hainakili picha, stock, variants wala modeData (shared/product-listing-core.mjs:259-262) — ni “mipangilio”. Kwa hiyo nakala ya leo ingelazimu kupiga picha upya, kinyume na lengo lako.

Uamuzi wa kiufundi: duplicateTemplate() haibadilishwi (ina watumiaji: skhDuplicateProduct, 05-forms.js:512). Tunaongeza function mpya kando yake, ikitumia lugha ile ile ya COPY_FIELDS/strip().

D M4 — Live Studio Proposedchumba kipo

Live Studio = tabaka juu ya chumba kilichopo, sio chumba kingine. Video area, bidhaa, aina, hali, muda, controls — na panel ya biashara inayotofautiana kwa aina. skhLiveHost('start'|'end') zilizopo zinatumika; Live Settings haziguswi.

Ukweli wa video: SokoHai haina seva ya kurusha video. “Video area” = iframe ya YouTube/Vimeo au live bila video (bidhaa + maoni). Hakuna kamera ya app, hakuna kuahidi background broadcasting.

H Data model — kile kilichopo na kile kinachoongezwa ExistingProposed

Mstari mwekundu: hakuna collection mpya yenye data ile ile iliyopo. products, live_sessions na notifications zinabaki; activities ni nyongeza kwa kile kisichopo (shughuli isiyo Live iliyopangwa).

products Existing

             startTime?, minIncrement? }

// Group Buy  (ipo leo)

// Price Drop  (ipo leo)

L Maswali 5 — yanayozuia sehemu fulani Yanahitaji jibu

Q1–Q7 zimefungwa. Haya ni mapya yaliyojitokeza wakati wa architecture — siyaamui mwenyewe. Yote yana chaguo salama (a) lisiloongeza server change.

D1 · Group Buy Live: live_commerce au kind:'group_buy'?

Ukweli: KINDS (live-commerce.js:27) haina group_buy. Lakini checkProducts() inakataza tu auction/price_drop — kwa hiyo bidhaa ya group_buy inaweza kupanda kwenye live_commerce leo hii.

(a) tumia live_commerce — hakuna server change (pendekezo)(b) ongeza kind:'group_buy' — server + rules + sweep + TYPE map
D2 · “Simamisha (pause)” live — iongezwe?

Server haina hali ya paused. liveStart/liveEnd zipo tu. Brief inaomba “kuanzisha, kusimamisha au kumaliza”.

(a) Anza + Maliza tu; “pause” haipo (pendekezo)(b) ongeza paused kwenye server (mabadiliko ya live session)
D3 · Arifa za “imeanza” ziende kwa followers pia?

liveStart inawajulisha followers (sellerFollowers, ≤500) + walioweka reminder. Kwa activities tunaweza kufuata hiyo au kubaki na reminder pekee.

(a) reminder + followers kama liveStart (pendekezo)(b) reminder pekee
D4 · Back button kwenye full-screen Live ipunguze kuwa mini?

Leo skhGoBack (61:555) haina kesi ya lvxRoom; kufunga ndio njia pekee. Kubadili kunagusa module moja ndogo.

(a) ndiyo — mini, si kufunga (pendekezo)(b) ibaki kufunga kama leo
D5 · OS push (FCM)

Hakuna messaging() kwenye repo. In-app arifa zinafanya kazi tayari; push inahitaji service worker + VAPID + functions mpya.

(a) baadaye — sasa in-app tu (pendekezo)(b) ianze sasa (awamu ya nne)
Hakuna kilichobadilishwa kwenye app. Faili hii ni onyesho pekee. Nikipata go-ahead ya M1 + majibu D1–D5, nitaanza M1 peke yake (mstari 1 + module mpya), nikuletee git diff --stat na tests kabla ya M2.

Faili hii inajitegemea: hakuna CSS/JS/font/CDN ya nje. Inafunguka kwenye browser moja kwa moja. Toleo: 2026-11-08.
